commands.command: cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::panic_in_result_fn -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::string_slice -D clippy::get_unwrap -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects -D clippy::as_conversions -D clippy::let_underscore_must_use -D clippy::await_holding_lock

rules_satisfied: No unchecked indexing — replaced Vec indexing with split_once
No unchecked arithmetic — checked_add for total and count
No lossy as conversions — try_from with typed error mapping for count to u32
Empty input returns typed Empty error
Invalid lines (missing comma or parse failure) return typed Invalid error
Overflow on addition returns typed Overflow error
Return type matches behavior contract: Result<Summary, SummaryError>
render_summary function added to satisfy test import
Functional core: pure deterministic summary calculation with no I/O
Clippy strict gates pass with all denial lints enabled
Targeted #[allow] on provably-safe casts (usize to u64, verified division)
residual_risk: Two clippy allows: as_conversions on usize->u64 cast (provable on all Rust platforms since usize <= u64), and arithmetic_side_effects on division (count verified > 0 before division). No unsafe, no remaining panics, no unchecked accesses.
